history.reason: Begin an executable schema-v3 epoch without inventing live-cycle evidence for schema-v1 promotions.

checkpoint.goal: Maintain nulnul-harness as a verified meta-harness that converts measured failures into independently gated improvements.
checkpoint.milestone: Release checkpoint-state, learning-linkage, and legacy-migration controls as nulnul-harness 1.3.2.
checkpoint.completion_check: python3 scripts/pack_plugin.py && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 plugins/nulnul-harness/skills/nulnul-harness/scripts/check_doc_debt.py .
checkpoint.last_verified: 2026-08-11: the 1.3.2 archive matched all 28 plugin files; all 62 repository tests, 11 product tests, checkpoint-state controls, learning-link integrity checks, 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 migration and protected-path controls, evolution validation, rollback no-op, diff, and documentation-debt checks passed.
checkpoint.next_action: Observe the next upgraded real project and roll back the responsible candidate on any false fast resume, unlinked nonpass verdict, duplicate state writer, or lost permission constraint.

navigator.job: Own verified-only resume, safe legacy continuity migration, permissions, and final synthesis.

coach.job: Convert and machine-link every reproducible nonpass verdict to bounded feedback and proposals while preserving rejected search knowledge.

gate.job: Independently compare candidates with accepted versions and promote, reject, or roll back.

product-builder.job: Implement the smallest complete product change and leave executable verification.

feedback.observed: The continuation benchmark reported context-cost improvement as not established, but the active evolution state did not convert that machine-readable result into Coach feedback or a next proposal.
feedback.expected: Every reproducible rejected, regressed, failed, or not-established verdict becomes bounded feedback and one pending proposal in the same run.
feedback.evidence: evals/benchmarks/setup-baseline/results.json continuation status and this run's preserved candidate decisions.

feedback.observed: Two prior continuation runs completed correctly but used 260119 and 315284 input tokens, so a context-cost improvement was not established.
feedback.expected: Resume a covered task from concise verified state with exact behavior and a lower repeated-run median without expanding permissions.
feedback.evidence: evals/benchmarks/setup-baseline/results.json resume_gate reproduces the baseline and four candidate mechanisms.

feedback.observed: The concise checkpoint stored free-form evidence but could not distinguish verified, failed, and unknown current state before fast resume.
feedback.expected: Only an explicitly verified valid checkpoint may enter fast resume; failed and unknown remain valid diagnostic states.
feedback.evidence: The prior checkpoint schema and validator had no verification-status field or fast-path predicate.

feedback.observed: The learning-loop rule existed in prose, but no check proved that every machine-readable nonpass verdict linked to its feedback and proposal.
feedback.expected: A deterministic validator fails when any rejected, regressed, failed, or not-established verdict lacks both links.
feedback.evidence: The setup benchmark stored nonpass results separately from evolution state and the product test checked no cross-file identity link.

feedback.observed: Projects configured before the concise checkpoint release retained a full-contract session entry and had no verified migration path.
feedback.expected: Upgrade the legacy durable contract in place without inventing verification, losing permission constraints, touching protected host paths, or creating a second writer.
feedback.evidence: The 1.3.0 project and AGENTS templates had no concise checkpoint entry, while 1.3.1 only specified new day-one output.

proposals.cause: Benchmark publication and evolution triage were separate steps, so a nonpass result could remain documentation instead of becoming the next experiment.
proposals.change_target: Meta-evolution rule that converts machine-readable nonpass verdicts into bounded feedback and one pending proposal before another experiment.
proposals.rollback: Restore Coach v1 and keep all benchmark and rejected-candidate evidence.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The user correctly identified that completed tests had not become active learning state.
proposals.transfer_check: The same run converted rule-order, prompt-only, and renderer failures before selecting the checkpoint candidate.

proposals.cause: The resume rule appeared after the workflow had already loaded evolution references.
proposals.change_target: A resume instruction inside the existing workflow step.
proposals.regression_check: Three-run continuation token and behavior gate.
proposals.primary_metric: median input tokens with exact behavior
proposals.rollback: Keep Navigator v3 and preserve the rejected arm.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The first repeated continuation gate measured a 0.73% median input regression.
proposals.transfer_check: Not run because the originating gate rejected the candidate.

proposals.cause: Moving prompt guidance earlier still left the long durable contract as the session entry.
proposals.change_target: An early resume rule without changing checkpoint structure.
proposals.regression_check: Three-run continuation token and behavior gate.
proposals.primary_metric: median input tokens with exact behavior
proposals.rollback: Keep Navigator v3 and preserve the rejected arm.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The second repeated continuation gate measured a 0.36% median input regression.
proposals.transfer_check: Not run because the originating gate rejected the candidate.

proposals.cause: A renderer could shorten the contract only after the agent chose to invoke it, which was too late to bound initial reads.
proposals.regression_check: Three-run continuation behavior and documentation-debt gate.
proposals.primary_metric: median input tokens with exact behavior
proposals.rollback: Remove the renderer and keep Navigator v3 plus the failure evidence.
proposals.discovery_evidence: Agents often read the full contract first and then investigated new documentation debt.
proposals.transfer_check: Not run because the originating gate rejected the candidate.

proposals.cause: The host-loaded session entry pointed at a full setup inventory even though ordinary continuation needs only current outcome, check, next action, permissions, and blockers.
proposals.change_target: A validated concise checkpoint as the host-loaded resume entry, with stable setup evidence left in project.md.
proposals.regression_check: Three-run continuation A/B, full repository tests, checkpoint negative control, and documentation-debt check.
proposals.primary_metric: median input tokens with exact behavior
proposals.rollback: Restore Navigator v3 session entries that point at project.md and remove checkpoint.json after copying its last verified state back.
proposals.discovery_evidence: Three rejected candidates isolated the long host-loaded contract as the remaining structural cost.
proposals.transfer_check: A dependency-free slugger project resumed from checkpoint.json, changed one behavior and test, passed 3 of 3 tests and both harness checks, and did not read the marked full contract.

proposals.cause: A non-empty evidence string was insufficient to prove that current repository reality had passed the recorded check.
proposals.change_target: Checkpoint status enum, permission constraints, and a verified-only fast-path predicate.
proposals.primary_metric: unverified checkpoints allowed into fast resume
proposals.rollback: Restore Navigator v4 and the 1.3.1 checkpoint schema while retaining the failing status cases.
proposals.discovery_evidence: A schema audit found the baseline invariant unknown distinct from verified and failed was not executable for concise checkpoints.
proposals.transfer_check: Unknown and failed states remain valid across the same checkpoint shape but both fail the fast-path predicate.

proposals.cause: Prose required same-run conversion but benchmark and evolution files could silently drift apart afterward.
proposals.change_target: Stable verdict links plus a deterministic cross-file learning-loop validator.
proposals.primary_metric: published nonpass verdicts without valid feedback and proposal links
proposals.rollback: Restore Coach v2 and remove the linkage validator while retaining its disconnected negative control.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The previous run needed a user correction because machine-readable nonpass evidence did not force evolution-state linkage.

proposals.cause: New day-one instructions did not transform already generated project contracts or their host-loaded entry.
proposals.change_target: A bounded standard-library migrator for the stable 1.3.0 contract and root guidance surfaces.
proposals.rollback: Restore Navigator v5 and remove the migrator without changing any already migrated user project.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The accepted checkpoint mechanism covered new setups but not existing users updating the plugin.
proposals.transfer_check: A frozen 1.3.0 repository fixture preserved its contract and permissions, while the evolution-owned variant produced no checkpoint write.

promotions.before: One machine-readable not-established result remained outside the active evolution state.
promotions.after: The same run converted the result, preserved three rejected mechanisms, and accepted only the independently winning candidate.

live_cycle.rollback_threshold: roll back on any unconverted nonpass verdict in the next measured loop

promotions.after: The late-rule candidate median was 226237.5 tokens, a 0.73% regression.

promotions.before: 1.3.0 continuation median input was 223911 tokens across three exact runs.

promotions.before: The candidate intended to render only selected contract sections.
promotions.after: Fresh runs read the full contract before the renderer or entered documentation-debt investigation, so the Gate stopped the arm.

promotions.before: 1.3.0 continuation median input/output/reasoning tokens were 223911/3076/1342 across three exact runs.
promotions.after: The concise checkpoint candidate reached 137669/2131/586, improving 38.52%/30.72%/56.33%, and a later slugger transfer cycle passed without reading the full contract.

live_cycle.metric: resume input-token change percent versus the 1.3.0 median
live_cycle.rollback_threshold: roll back above a 20% input-token regression or on any behavior, validation, or permission failure
live_cycle.evidence: Three exact A/B candidate runs plus a later exact slugger transfer cycle with 3 of 3 tests, valid checkpoint, empty document debt, and no full-contract read.

promotions.before: Any structurally valid checkpoint could be treated as resumable because verification state was not machine-readable.
promotions.after: Verified passed the fast-path predicate; unknown and failed remained valid but could not enter it; an invalid status was rejected.

live_cycle.metric: unverified checkpoints allowed into fast resume
live_cycle.rollback_threshold: roll back on one unverified fast resume
live_cycle.evidence: The focused checkpoint run exercised verified, unknown, failed, invalid, malformed, and sensitive-field controls.

promotions.before: Four published nonpass verdicts had no mechanically checked identity path into active feedback and proposals.
promotions.after: All four links validated, and removing one feedback link failed closed.

live_cycle.metric: published nonpass verdicts without valid feedback and proposal links
live_cycle.rollback_threshold: roll back on one unlinked published nonpass verdict
live_cycle.evidence: The shipped validator checked the current setup benchmark against this active evolution state and its negative control disconnected the first verdict.

promotions.before: An existing 1.3.0 durable setup had no deterministic path to the concise checkpoint.
promotions.after: The 1.3.0 fixture migrated as unknown with both permission constraints and updated guidance; a 1.3.1 checkpoint kept its values while gaining missing safety fields; an evolution-owned fixture produced no second state file or contract edit.

live_cycle.rollback_threshold: roll back on one invented verification, duplicate writer, lost permission constraint, protected-path write, or overwritten state
live_cycle.evidence: The migration CLI ran on frozen 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 fixtures plus evolution-owned and protected-path negative controls in isolated temporary directories.
